name: protein kinase C iota

function.text: PRKCI encodes protein kinase C iota type. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in intracellular signal transduction and secretion.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

function.text: PRKCI encodes protein kinase C iota type. Based in part on similarity, it is a calcium- and diacylglycerol-independent serine/ threonine-protein kinase that plays a general protective role against apoptotic stimuli, is involved in NF-kappa-B activation, cell survival, differentiation and polarity, and contributes to the regulation of microtubule dynamics in the early secretory pathway. It functions in the organization of the apical domain in epithelial cells by phosphorylating EZR. This step is crucial for activation and normal distribution of EZR at the early stages of intestinal epithelial cell differentiation.
